GeneratedDocument.title: Generated document
GeneratedDocument.description: The humaniq-side record of one attempt to render a standard HR document (arbeidsovereenkomst, aanbiedingsbrief, werkgeversverklaring, getuigschrift, loonstrook, jaaropgaaf) via docudesk's template/rendering engine and store the returned PDF (humaniq-docudesk-documents, extended by payslip-pdf-docudesk). humaniq owns no template or PDF machinery of its own (design.md D1): this schema is a log of the handoff -- which template, for whom, the outcome, and where the file landed -- never the rendering itself. `skipped-no-docudesk` and `failed` are retryable outcomes: a later `occ humaniq:documents:generate` invocation (or the EmploymentContractDetail/PayslipDetail page action) can supersede them (design.md D6). At most one GeneratedDocument per idempotency key may be `pending`/`generated` at a time: the four letter types key on (contractId|employeeId, documentType), loonstrook keys on (payslipId, documentType), jaaropgaaf keys on (jaaropgaafId, documentType) -- enforced by HrDocumentService and audited by the nl-contract-schriftelijk / nl-loonstrook-verplicht corpus rules.

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: Which standard HR document this record represents. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not. loonstrook/jaaropgaaf added by payslip-pdf-docudesk.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee this document is for.

contractId.title: Contract
contractId.description: Reference to the EmploymentContract this document evidences -- required in practice for arbeidsovereenkomst; null for employee-level document types (aanbiedingsbrief/werkgeversverklaring/getuigschrift/loonstrook/jaaropgaaf).

payslipId.title: Payslip
payslipId.description: Reference to the Payslip this loonstrook document renders (payslip-pdf-docudesk) -- set only on documentType: loonstrook; null on every other type.

jaaropgaafId.title: Jaaropgaaf
jaaropgaafId.description: Reference to the Jaaropgaaf annual aggregate this document renders (payslip-pdf-docudesk) -- set only on documentType: jaaropgaaf; null on every other type.

templateRef.title: Template
templateRef.description: The docudesk template UUID actually used to render this document -- plain string, NOT $ref, because it targets another app's register (ADR-062 rule 7: only fields whose target exists in this register set get $ref).

status.title: Status
status.description: Outcome of this generation attempt. failed/skipped-no-docudesk are superseded by a retry; only one pending/generated record may exist per (contract|employee, documentType).

filePath.title: File path
filePath.description: Path of the stored PDF in this object's own OpenRegister folder (written via FileService::addFile), or null while pending/failed/skipped.

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Failure or skip diagnostic (e.g. docudesk unavailable, ambiguous/missing template, storage failure).

generatedAt.title: Generated at
generatedAt.description: When the PDF was produced by docudesk and stored on this object's folder.

Jaaropgaaf.title: Jaaropgaaf
Jaaropgaaf.description: The per-employee-per-year annual-statement aggregate (payslip-pdf-docudesk design.md D2): totals derived exclusively from the employee's Payslips for the given year -- never fabricated, never containing figures no Payslip field carries. Created and updated exclusively by HrDocumentService's aggregation step, upserted per (employeeId, year): re-aggregating refreshes an existing object's totals and `aggregatedAt` rather than creating a duplicate. Carries no status/lifecycle -- render state lives on the GeneratedDocument that renders it (D1).

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee this annual statement is for.

year.title: Year
year.description: The kalenderjaar this annual statement aggregates.

totalGrossPay.title: Total gross pay
totalGrossPay.description: Sum of Payslip.grossPay across the year's payslips (the jaaropgaaf 'loon' column).

totalLoonheffing.title: Total loonheffing
totalLoonheffing.description: Sum of Payslip.loonheffing across the year's payslips.

totalNettoPay.title: Total net pay
totalNettoPay.description: Sum of Payslip.nettoPay across the year's payslips.

totalZvwWithheld.title: Total Zvw withheld
totalZvwWithheld.description: Sum of Payslip.zvw ONLY where zvwMode == 'inhouding' -- the employer levy (werkgeversheffing) is never a werknemersaandeel and is excluded from this sum.

totalPensionContribution.title: Total pension contribution
totalPensionContribution.description: Sum of Payslip.pensionContribution across the year's payslips.

totalVakantiegeldReserved.title: Total vakantiegeld reserved
totalVakantiegeldReserved.description: Sum of Payslip.vakantiegeldReserved across the year's payslips -- the reservation, not the payout.

payPeriodCount.title: Pay period count
payPeriodCount.description: Number of payslips aggregated into this jaaropgaaf.

verrekendeArbeidskorting.title: Verrekende arbeidskorting
verrekendeArbeidskorting.description: Statutory jaaropgaaf line for the applied arbeidskorting -- stays null because no Payslip field carries arbeidskorting today (a payroll-core follow-up); never a fabricated 0.00 presented as fact.

loonheffingennummer.title: Loonheffingennummer
loonheffingennummer.description: Employer loonheffingennummer, snapshotted from configuration at aggregation time.

aggregatedAt.title: Aggregated at
aggregatedAt.description: When the aggregation last ran -- refreshed on every upsert.

objects.errorMessage: Docudesk was niet geïnstalleerd op het moment van deze poging; opnieuw proberen zodra docudesk beschikbaar is.
